description: Defines a class PermissionsSystemScheme for testing and asserting permission toggles in the Mattermost system console's user management permissions UI, specifically for the 'System Scheme' section.

classes.name: PermissionsSystemScheme
classes.description: A class for interacting with and asserting the state of permission toggles in the System Scheme section of the Mattermost system console.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the system scheme header is visible.

methods.name: getManageChannelAutoTranslationRows
methods.description: Retrieves permission rows related to 'Manage Channel Auto Translation' within a specified section.

methods.name: expectManageChannelAutoTranslationChecked
methods.description: Asserts that the 'Manage Channel Auto Translation' permission is checked (ON) in a given section.

methods.name: expectManageChannelAutoTranslationUnchecked
methods.description: Asserts that the 'Manage Channel Auto Translation' permission is not checked (OFF) in a given section.
